messages.en: Has tomorrow's meeting really been cancelled?
Yeah, the boss just told us in the group chat.

senses.en_definition: To allow or give permission for something.
To accept or confirm something as true or valid.

collocations.en: the news I confirmed as true
the statement you accepted as true

senses.en_definition: To agree with or acknowledge the correctness of what someone says.

messages.en: The teacher's said we can use the hall tomorrow afternoon, but we have to tidy up afterwards.
Okay, I can help set up the chairs. Who do we get the key from?
From the school office. I'll pick it up tomorrow before you guys get there.

senses.en_definition: Feeling strong dislike or aversion towards someone or something.

messages.en: I really hate it when people cancel plans at the last minute. I was already ready when he said he couldn't make it!
Ugh, I get it. Have you left home yet?
Not yet. But it's so annoying. He could've just told me earlier.

senses.en_definition: A thing or object referred to without specifying its name or exact nature.
Physical matter or entities that have tangible form, as opposed to spirit.

messages.en: Have you seen my charger? The white one.
I put it on the dining table. Try looking under the newspaper.
Ah, there it is! No wonder I couldn't see it earlier.
